critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: Backend Developer and Frontend Developer must be dedicated (not shared) across Phases 2–4 due to critical path dependency; PM and UX Designer front-loaded in Phase 1 with reduced allocation in Phases 2–3.

phases.name: Discovery & Design
milestones: Stakeholder alignment session completed and scope signed off
User personas and success metrics defined and agreed
Architecture and API integration design approved
E-signature vendor selected and contract executed
SOC 2 compliance scope clarified (Type I vs. Type II, pre- vs. post-launch)

tasks.name: Conduct stakeholder alignment session and document scope sign-off
tasks.definition_of_done: Scope document signed by HR VP, IT Director, and CEO; all hard constraints and open questions reviewed and resolved.

tasks.name: Define user personas and success metrics for new hire and HR admin
tasks.definition_of_done: Personas document and success metrics dashboard template delivered; stakeholder review completed.

tasks.name: Design system architecture, API integration flows, and database schema
tasks.definition_of_done: Architecture diagram, Workday/Azure AD/e-signature API integration flows, and PostgreSQL schema approved by tech lead and PM.

tasks.name: Create wireframes and user flow diagrams for onboarding portal UI
tasks.definition_of_done: Wireframes for new hire dashboard, document submission, team intro, and HR admin dashboard delivered; stakeholder feedback incorporated.

tasks.name: Confirm e-signature vendor selection and execute contract
tasks.definition_of_done: E-signature vendor contract signed; API documentation and sandbox access confirmed; integration roadmap documented.

tasks.name: Validate Workday API sandbox availability and document integration requirements
tasks.definition_of_done: Workday API sandbox confirmed accessible; API documentation reviewed; integration requirements and custom development needs documented.

tasks.name: Clarify SOC 2 compliance scope and audit timeline with security team
tasks.definition_of_done: SOC 2 Type I vs. Type II decision made; pre-launch vs. post-launch audit timeline confirmed; compliance checklist created.

phases.name: Core Development (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 1–2: New hire dashboard and document submission UI complete; Azure AD SSO working
Sprint 3–4: Workday API integration and e-signature service integration complete
Sprint 5: Core features end-to-end tested; internal demo with stakeholders completed
IT account provisioning automation (email, Slack) implemented and tested

tasks.name: Set up React frontend project, component library, and TypeScript configuration
tasks.definition_of_done: React project scaffolded with TypeScript, ESLint, and component library initialized; development environment documented.

tasks.name: Implement Azure AD SSO authentication and login flow
tasks.definition_of_done: Azure AD OAuth 2.0 integration complete; new hire can log in with Azure AD credentials; session management and token refresh working.

tasks.name: Build new hire dashboard UI with onboarding checklist and task tracking
tasks.definition_of_done: Dashboard displays all onboarding tasks with due dates and completion status; task filtering and sorting working; responsive design verified.

tasks.name: Implement document upload and e-signature integration with DocuSign/Adobe Sign
tasks.definition_of_done: New hire can upload I-9, W-4, direct deposit forms; e-signature service integration complete; signed documents stored securely in database.

tasks.name: Build document submission UI with form validation and file upload
tasks.definition_of_done: Document submission form displays with required fields; file upload working; form validation prevents submission of incomplete data; error messages clear.

tasks.name: Implement Workday API integration to fetch new hire data and pre-populate forms
tasks.definition_of_done: Workday API calls retrieve new hire name, email, department, manager; form fields pre-populated; error handling for API failures implemented.

tasks.name: Build team introduction UI with team member profiles and photos
tasks.definition_of_done: Team member profiles display with name, role, photo, and bio; profiles searchable and filterable by department; responsive design verified.

tasks.name: Implement IT account provisioning automation for email and Slack
tasks.definition_of_done: Email account created automatically in Azure; Slack account provisioned and added to team channels; provisioning status tracked in database.

tasks.name: Build HR admin dashboard UI for monitoring onboarding progress
tasks.definition_of_done: HR admin dashboard displays all new hires with task completion status and document submission status; filtering and sorting working; export to CSV available.

tasks.name: Implement backend API endpoints for HR admin dashboard queries
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoints return new hire list, task completion status, document submission status; pagination and filtering working; response times < 500ms.

tasks.name: Conduct internal demo with stakeholders and incorporate feedback
tasks.definition_of_done: Demo completed with HR VP, IT Director, and sample new hire; feedback documented; prioritized backlog for Phase 3 created.

phases.name: Integration & Edge Cases (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 6–7: All integrations tested end-to-end; edge cases and error handling complete
Sprint 8: Security review and SOC 2 Type I compliance checklist completed
All critical bugs resolved; system ready for UAT

tasks.name: Test Workday API integration with edge cases (missing fields, API timeouts, retries)
tasks.definition_of_done: Test cases for missing Workday fields, API timeouts, and retry logic executed; all edge cases handled gracefully; error messages logged.

tasks.name: Test e-signature integration with multiple document types and signing scenarios
tasks.definition_of_done: Test cases for I-9, W-4, direct deposit form signing completed; signed documents verified in database; audit trail captured.

tasks.name: Test IT account provisioning with error scenarios (duplicate accounts, provisioning failures)
tasks.definition_of_done: Test cases for duplicate account prevention, provisioning failures, and retry logic executed; error notifications sent to IT admin.

tasks.name: Implement data validation, error handling, and logging across all API endpoints
tasks.definition_of_done: All API endpoints validate input; errors logged with context; audit logs capture all user actions and system events; log retention policy implemented.

tasks.name: Conduct security review and implement SOC 2 Type I compliance controls
tasks.definition_of_done: Security review completed; access controls implemented; audit logging verified; SOC 2 Type I compliance checklist signed off by security team.

tasks.name: Execute end-to-end integration testing across all systems (Workday, Azure AD, e-signature, email, Slack)
tasks.definition_of_done: New hire completes full onboarding flow from login to document signing to IT account provisioning; all integrations verified working; no critical bugs.

tasks.name: Test accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and responsive design across devices
tasks.definition_of_done: Accessibility audit completed; WCAG 2.1 AA compliance verified; responsive design tested on mobile, tablet, desktop; no critical accessibility issues.

tasks.name: Resolve all critical and high-priority bugs identified in testing
tasks.definition_of_done: All critical bugs fixed and verified; high-priority bugs resolved or deferred to post-launch; bug tracking system updated.

tasks.name: Prepare UAT test cases and documentation for HR and IT stakeholders
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT test cases documented; test data prepared; UAT environment configured; stakeholder training scheduled.

phases.name: QA & Testing
milestones: UAT completed with HR and IT stakeholders; sign-off obtained
Performance testing completed; system meets SLA targets
Runbooks, training materials, and post-launch support plan documented

tasks.name: Execute UAT with HR administrators and IT staff; document findings
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT completed with at least 2 HR admins and 1 IT admin; all test cases executed; findings documented; sign-off obtained from stakeholders.

tasks.name: Resolve UAT-identified bugs and conduct regression testing
tasks.definition_of_done: All UAT bugs fixed; regression testing completed; no new bugs introduced; UAT sign-off confirmed.

tasks.name: Conduct performance testing and load testing; verify SLA targets (response time < 500ms, 99.9% uptime)
tasks.definition_of_done: Load testing completed with 100+ concurrent users; response times < 500ms verified; database query optimization completed; performance report delivered.

tasks.name: Create runbooks, training materials, and post-launch support plan for HR and IT teams
tasks.definition_of_done: Runbooks for common HR and IT tasks documented; training materials created; post-launch support plan (escalation, on-call rotation) defined; team trained.

tasks.name: Prepare adoption and communication plan for new hire rollout
tasks.definition_of_done: Adoption plan includes communication timeline, new hire onboarding email, FAQ, and success metrics dashboard; stakeholder review completed.

tasks.name: Finalize post-launch ownership and maintenance plan
tasks.definition_of_done: Post-launch owner assigned; maintenance SLA defined; bug fix and feature request process documented; handoff meeting completed.

phases.name: Deployment & Handoff
milestones: Production deployment completed; smoke testing passed
Go-live sign-off obtained from HR VP and IT Director
Post-launch monitoring and support plan activated

tasks.name: Deploy application to Azure App Service production environment
tasks.definition_of_done: Application deployed to production; database migrations completed; environment variables configured; deployment verified in logs.

tasks.name: Execute smoke testing in production environment
tasks.definition_of_done: Smoke tests executed in production; new hire login, document submission, and IT account provisioning verified; no critical issues found.

tasks.name: Obtain go-live sign-off from HR VP and IT Director
tasks.definition_of_done: Go-live sign-off email received from HR VP and IT Director; launch date confirmed; communication to new hires scheduled.

tasks.name: Activate post-launch monitoring, alerting, and support rotation
tasks.definition_of_done: Monitoring dashboards configured; alerting rules active; on-call rotation started; support team briefed on escalation procedures.
